What it is

AP 24®

According to Nu Skin material, this toothpaste brightens teeth without peroxide while helping to prevent cavities and plaque build-up. The vanilla mint flavor keeps breath fresh through the day.

It cleans with a mix of Hydrated Silica and Alumina, a gentle combination that smooths and polishes teeth without wearing away enamel. The AP 24 formula itself contains a patented, pharmaceutical-grade plaque-prevention ingredient that leaves a protective layer on the teeth.

Who it suits

You whose teeth are stained by coffee, tea, food or smoking and want to return to your natural tooth shade. It is not a bleaching product, so it will not make teeth whiter than their natural color.

Benefits

What its official material says.

According to Nu Skin material

  • Helps brighten teeth without peroxide
  • A long-lasting clean, fresh feeling in the mouth
  • Helps prevent cavities and plaque
  • A fresh vanilla mint flavor

How to use

Here is how to use it.

01

Adults and children 6 and over

Brush thoroughly after meals or at least twice a day, or as your dentist advises.

02

Children under 6

Teach good brushing and rinsing habits to minimize swallowing, and supervise until they can do it alone.

03

Children under 2

Ask a dentist first.

Inside

From the label and official material.

Ingredients

Water (Aqua), Hydrated Silica, Sorbitol, Aluminium Hydroxide, Glycerin, Tetrasodium Pyrophosphate, PEG-12, Flavor (Aroma), Cellulose Gum, Poloxamer 338, Poloxamer 407, Sodium Lauryl Sulfate, Sodium Monofluorophosphate, Dimethicone, Titanium Dioxide, Sodium Saccharin.

Good to know

Read this first.

Important about fluoride: the title on the Product Information Page says “fluoride-free”, but its body text and ingredient list contain Sodium Monofluorophosphate, a form of fluoride. So this toothpaste does contain fluoride. If you avoid fluoride, do not use it.

Keep out of reach of children under 6.

FAQ

Frequently asked.

How is it different from other whitening toothpastes?

According to Nu Skin material, it uses no peroxide, which can damage enamel and irritate soft mouth tissue, and no harsh abrasives that can scratch teeth.

Will it make teeth whiter than their natural color?

No. It is not a tooth bleach. If your teeth are darker because of food, drink or smoking, it helps lift those stains and returns teeth to their natural color.

Does it contain fluoride or not?

Yes. Sodium Monofluorophosphate is a form of fluoride permitted to help prevent cavities, even though the PIP title says “fluoride-free”.
